scripts.text:
- Wait a minute !! -
- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -

[Lime Evenor]
Thanks to many adventurers visiting our Eden Group, we've recently prepared a new version of Eden Group Mark for our visitors.
And it is also possible to exchange old version of Eden Group Mark into a new one.

[Lime Evenor]
Though it has a slight time delay, this new version of Eden Group Mark will send you back to current saved location.
Would you like to exchange yours?
Sure
I'm good.

[Lime Evenor]
What possible reason would you have... to not exchange?

[Lime Evenor]
There you go. Come back again~

[Lime Evenor]
People who follow their dreams and romances listen to me. We are representatives of the paradise called 'The garden of Eden' called the Eden group . There is no place like this anywhere.
Hello. Can I help you?
What is Eden group?
Join the Eden Group.
Register new mission.
Search for missions.
Cancel.

[Lime Evenor]
Eden Group is a group that helps people who are suffering from distresses in Midgard.

[Lime Evenor]
If people need help, we put up the case on the bulletin board and introduce it to our members who are eager to help those in need.

[Lime Evenor]
Eden members will review the missions and help those who post them up.
Members do these missions for rewards.

[Lime Evenor]
If you are not too familiar with Midgard, this is a great way to explore the world.
Or, if you are mature enough, you can travel the world and make new friends while doing missions. Your honorable name will be spread out among lands.

[Lime Evenor]
You can be a Eden's member by simply registering with me.
Would you like to join Eden Group?
Yes, I want to join.
No, I don't want to join.

[Lime Evenor]
Aright. Excellent! Please write down your name here.

[Lime Evenor]
Are you done?
Let me see.

[Lime Evenor]
Your name is ^3131FFBo{0}Ba^000000...? Is that right?
Huh? Isn't it??

[Lime Evenor]
Hmm, that isn't what you wrote?
Ok, hmm, it seems a bit hard to read.

[Lime Evenor]
Would you please write your name again? Please write it ^3131FFClearly^000000.

[Lime Evenor]
Ah~ ha. You are ^3131FF{0}^000000.
I got it right this time.

[Lime Evenor]
We already put your name on the list.
Welcome to Eden's group new member!

[Lime Evenor]
Hopefully you can do great work as an Eden's member.

[Lime Evenor]
Do you still have questions about Eden Group?

[Lime Evenor]
You are already a member of Eden Group.

[Lime Evenor]
Do you want to register some missions that you want us to do?
Yes, I want to register.
No, I don't.

[Lime Evenor]
Alrigh. Please write down your name on it.

[Lime Evenor]
^3131FF{0}^000000.. Is that your name?
Hmm, your handwriting is not clear. I can't read. it

[Lime Evenor]
^3131FF{0}^000000, tell me what you want to register for.
Which map should we go to?

[Lime Evenor]
^3131FFMission Map: {0}^000000
hum, I will note that.

[Lime Evenor]
Please let me know what kind of missions your are lookng for.
It should be briefly like 'Hunt 10 Porings.'

[Lime Evenor]
Are you done?
Let me check.

[Lime Evenor]
Huh...........

[Lime Evenor]
Hum.. huh??..................

[Lime Evenor]
I think you should complete one of our missions first before you take up a new mission.

[Lime Evenor]
^3131FFClient: Lime Evenor^000000
^3131FFMission: Practice your handwriting for one month.^000000
You've got really bad penmanship!

[Lime Evenor]
^3131FFMission:{0}^000000
Anyway, you are done registering for a new mission.

[Lime Evenor]
Missions are fully booked. You have to wait for an spot to clear up.
Please kindly wait until your turn.

[Lime Evenor]
Would like to try some missions as an Eden member?

[Lime Evenor]
Check the right side of the bulletin board, there are various kinds of missions waiting for you.
Please carefully read the mission list and the qualifications and choose one of them.

[Lime Evenor]
You need to join Eden Group first if you want to do some missions.

[Lime Evenor]
If you have any questions please come back again.

[Eden Teleport Officer]
Those who are wandering around this strange world with aimless eyes listen up and come to me!
Eden group is here to help you and will show you the great future.

[Eden Teleport Officer]
You have nothing to do but waste your time?
You are eager to do something good but no one offers you work?
Would you like to be a problem solver?
Eden group is here to solve your problem.
Move to Eden Group.
Don't want to talk anymore.

[Eden Teleport Officer]
Let's go to our secret base!

[Eden Teleport Officer]
If you don't know what to do for your future, don't hesitate to tell me. Just drop by and talk to me! Ok?

[Lime Evenor]
Oh, it is an exclusive place only for Eden's members.
If you are a member, you can come whenever you want!
Enter.
Don't Enter.
This door is beautifully decorated but seems a little bit too heavy.

[Lime Evenor]
Well, if you are not interested.

[Lime Evenor]
Oh, this is an exclusive place for Eden's members only.
If you want to go inside, you have to join the Eden Group.

[Old Adventurer]
Harsh, I am strong enough even if I look old! What is her name? Lime Evenor? She just ignores me like I am a some kind of old senile bastard.

[Old Adventurer]
I came here to join the Eden group! I don't deserve this!
Do you also think I look like I'm senile?

[Eden's Chief]
Oh, Shoot! How many eggs have I done?
Aww!!! I totally forgot! I have to count again!

[Eden's Chief]
Why have you asked me to do this? What kind of mission is that?

[Eden's Chief]
What are you going to with all of those fried eggs? I am sure you can't eat all of them. You just want to bother me, right?

[Eden's Intern]
Actually, I realized that.

[Eden's Intern]
We have to work really hard unless you want to fail.

[Eden's Intern]
But, I have never learned about pharmaceuticals yet.

[Eden's Intern]
I'm going to fail. I can't do this.

[Neede]
I became a Eden's member several years ago, but it feels like it was yesterday.
I have been doing lots of work, so I didn't even notice how many years I spent here.

[Neede]
It reminds me that it was like a war everyday.

[Neede]
The chief of ^3131FFthe restaurant on the right side^000000
uses too much seasoning every time he cooks, the smell is all over the lobby. We have to open the window regularly because we can't stand the smell!

[Neede]
And, do you see the ^3131FFgymnasium^000000 on the cross of ^3131FFthe north side of the lobby^000000? They always shout when they exercise, I can even hear them from here!

[Neede]
Besides, the weird girl from ^3131FFthe second floor^000000 is crying all the time. Her cries drive me crazy.

[Neede]
Ah, that weird girl is actually our boss...

[Neede]
I don't know what she has been up to. But she cries and shouts all the time. Oh, sometimes I hear 'Bang!', loud booming sounds... I don't know where it came from.

[Neede]
Wait!
Shh! It is a secret, you can't tell anybody!
[Neede]
I don't trust Evenor. She never shows her feelings... she's going to snitch on me to my boss.

[Lime Evenor]
I am not that kind of girl.

[Neede]
Huh? Did you hear that? Gosh~!
